title: Change one item with set at
objective: Change a single item in a list or a single value in a map with set ... at ... to, when the collection was made changing.

body.text: set changes one item of a list or one value of a map. Write set, the name, at, the position or key, then to and the new value. The list or map must have been made changing. Other items stay the same.

body.title: Change a list item
body.code:
make changing numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
set numbers at 0 to 10
say numbers at 0

make changing letters equal to a list of "a", "b", "c"
set letters at 1 to "y"
say letters at 1

body.text: A map works the same way, with the key in place of the position. A new key cannot be added with set in this form; it changes a value that is already there.

body.title: Change a map value
body.code:
make changing ages equal to a map from "Ana" to 11
set ages at "Ana" to 12
say ages at "Ana"

make changing inventory equal to a map from "keys" to 0
set inventory at "keys" to 4
say inventory at "keys"

body.prompt: The program changes the third letter to z, but prints a instead. Make it print z.
body.starter:
make changing letters equal to a list of "a", "b", "c"
set letters at 2 to "z"
say letters at 0
body.solution:
make changing letters equal to a list of "a", "b", "c"
set letters at 2 to "z"
say letters at 2
